summary: Tested Affiliate Links feature end-to-end (backend pytest + frontend Playwright). Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%) covering auth gating, admin CRUD, public placement filtering, sort_order, active-filter, click tracking + privacy (clicks key not exposed publicly), 400 invalid placement, 404 unknown link. Frontend: Affiliati tab loads (Save lucide import fix verified), full create→edit→delete CRUD works, created link appears in correct public placement via /api/affiliate-links/calculator, and ALL 10 other admin tabs (Utenti, Vetrina, Newsletter, Segnalazioni, Preventivi, Richieste, Analytics, Email Log, Inviate, Codici) load with zero pageerrors confirming regression-clean.

minor.issue: No try/except on ObjectId(link_id) — passing a malformed id (not 24 hex chars) raises bson.errors.InvalidId and returns 500 instead of 400/404. Same for POST /affiliate-links/{link_id}/click.
Does not return 404 when link_id does not exist — silently returns {'message': 'Link aggiornato'} even when no document was updated (no matched_count check).
Same: no 404 on non-existent id, deleted_count not validated.

issues: File is 2219 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Should be split (AffiliateLinksTab, ProductsTab, UsersTab, etc. into separate files).

action_items: (Optional) Wrap ObjectId(link_id) calls in admin_update_affiliate / admin_delete_affiliate / track_affiliate_click with try/except InvalidId → return 400.
(Optional) Check matched_count / deleted_count in update/delete admin affiliate endpoints and return 404 when link_id does not exist.
(Tech debt) Split AdminPanelPage.js (2219 lines) into per-tab files.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py affiliate endpoints lack defensive ObjectId parsing and existence checks (see backend minor issues).
AffiliateLinksTab handleSave catches all errors with empty catch — useful logging would aid debugging in production.

Public placement set is duplicated between backend (line 3177 `{'guida','shop_footer','calculator','demo'}`) and frontend PLACEMENT_LABELS — consider exposing /api/affiliate-links/placements config to avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed affiliate links created during tests are deleted in fixture teardown and explicit delete calls. No residual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Affiliate Links feature is functional and regression-clean. Save lucide import fix at AdminPanelPage.js line 27 is verified working. All public placements (guida/shop_footer/calculator/demo) return correct filtered+sorted active links and DO NOT expose clicks count. Click tracking increments DB counter and returns target URL. Note: visual integration of <AffiliateLinks /> component into GuidePage/CalculatorPage/Shop Footer/DemoPage was NOT verified in this iteration (per request, second priority) — recommend a follow-up visual smoke if those pages need to show the affiliate cards.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs to RCA. The 'Save is not defined' bug fixed by main agent (added Save to lucide-react import on line 27) is verified working: AffiliateLinksTab loads, the save button (Save icon) renders, and clicking it successfully creates/updates links via /api/admin/affiliate-links. No console pageerrors during full admin tab traversal.
